validation.starting_kit: Four individual synthetic circular-bot fights,100HP/24damage,no items/bombs/godmode; each survived with100HP including1.5s post-death movement. Not mixed-room/human balance acceptance.
validation.source_check: Bouncer13native windows,18constants and preserved animation contract validate. Other three use pinned wiki/XML; exact native timers remain unmeasured.
validation.initial_regression_failures: Mechanics test binary was stale; rebuilt. Charm test still treated now-supported Rainbow ID25 as invalid; changed invalid-ID case to26. Boom fixture used a replaceable Gaper as unlimited fallback; aligned fixture to existing Pacer fallback. No production pool invariant relaxed.
validation.bouncer_clearance: Native inflated screenshot exposed wall overlap. Added short old-radius-swept correction and delayed retry when inflation footprint cannot yet fit; preserves shrink restoration radius. Dedicated wall regression passes.
validation.simulation_benchmark: 600ticks,seed1866,circular movement,godmode,no firing: batch3mean0.0396ms/max0.422ms; batch4mean0.0363ms/max0.301ms. Rendering excluded; not full dense acceptance.
validation.rendering_caveat: Isolated captures~60FPS; generated mixed-practice frame180capture showed26FPS versus55FPS for Charger practice. This observation is not a controlled renderer benchmark and is not certified performance parity. Later frame420capture showed45FPS after combat effects subsided. Simulation-only timing remained below0.05ms/step on average; renderer parity remains unaccepted.
